svg.aria-label: Paxos: consensus on one value: Two majorities always meet, and a proposer adopts what it hears instead of insisting.. ⟨PREPARE, ballot b⟩; ⟨PROMISE, b, the value I accepted, if any⟩; adopt the value of the highest ballot heard; ⟨ACCEPT, b, value⟩; ⟨ACCEPTED, b⟩ from a majority; ⟨DECIDED, value⟩. A value accepted by a majority is seen by every later ballot, so no two ballots can fix different values.
